# By JTT AI Game Development Pipeline

Canonical repository: https://github.com/jordan-thirkle/ai-game-development-pipeline

This GitHub Pages site is a read-only public status/documentation surface. It is not the local execution Studio and must not be treated as evidence that local execution, publication, branch protection, or private platform settings have occurred.

Machine-readable status: ./status.json
Deployment revision metadata: ./deployment.json
Security policy: https://github.com/jordan-thirkle/ai-game-development-pipeline/blob/main/SECURITY.md
Public repository data policy: https://github.com/jordan-thirkle/ai-game-development-pipeline/blob/main/docs/PUBLIC-REPOSITORY-DATA-POLICY.md
Issues/backlog: https://github.com/jordan-thirkle/ai-game-development-pipeline/issues

Current truthful execution boundary:
- Studio execution is local-only.
- Current executed runtime target is web.
- Desktop/mobile requests are planning and UX intent unless separately evidenced by an actual executor.
- Creator Mode is idea-first and maps ideas to reviewed starter shapes with transparent deterministic local rules; manual Fine-tune selections override suggestions.

Security baseline:
- CodeQL scanning is configured for the public repository.
- External GitHub Actions are governed by immutable-SHA validation, with any temporary exception required to be exact and documented.
- CI scans the tracked public tree for forbidden local/private paths and high-confidence credential formats.
- CI scans complete fetched Git history for configured high-confidence credential patterns.
- Main branch protection is not to be claimed until GitHub repository settings report it as enforced.
